_comment: The framework repo's own gate config (never installed: ci/ is excluded from the release zip and the installer). CI runs prose_check and constitution_lint (both strict) over the spine with it, on both runners; run them locally the same way. See enforcement-map.md, 'The framework repo's own checks'. Rule regexes are matched line by line in both twins (grep -E semantics): no \b, no backslash escapes inside brackets (write a literal tab as the JSON escape).

constitutionRules.message: POSIX sh only (Ubuntu sh is dash): no [[ ]], process substitution, declare/mapfile/readarray/typeset, ${v:n} or ${v//}
gate output is ASCII (section sign excepted: pin syntax) so the ps1/sh twins print the same bytes on every console
persona-guard forks nothing but git, rm and mkdir (PG.9): a fork costs ~80 ms on Windows, per tool call
